commit: fix(compiler-ssr): fix ssr compile error for select with non-option children

truth.description: processOption now reads props before it checks the tag, and the optgroup branch hands it every child the optgroup holds, so the single-space text node that parseChildren keeps between two options written on one line reaches it, and SSR-compiling a select v-model with such an optgroup throws a TypeError where the base compiled it.

distractions.why: The select's only child is a slot outlet, so no option gets the selected check and the compiled code needs none of the loose-equal helpers.
